verdict.rationale: Undermind's in-product AI takes delegated research work: it runs a deep literature review from an open-ended goal, plans its own searches, asks follow-up questions, and offers an AI expert to brainstorm with and generate custom tables. Community users confirm handing off searches and getting ranked results back. Delegation is documented only for literature search and analysis; the workspace actions (curating folders, starring papers, editing notes) are described as MCP tools for external agents, not as tasks the built-in assistant takes on. missing for 10: evidence the built-in assistant performs delegated tasks beyond search and synthesis (e.g., workspace organization or note editing inside the product), detailed first-party docs on the in-app assistant's scope.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Runs a deep literature review from an open-ended research goal and produces a ranked list of papers with a written synthesis. Plans its own searches, follows citations and key authors
Undermind asks follow-up questions to understand exactly what you need.
Brainstorm with an AI expert that has read the relevant literature. Generate custom tables to support your research.
Iterate on reports, dive into full texts, extract details, and refine your understanding.
The best results the user has gotten from an AI research assistant.
